output.answer:
The five artists with the most albums are:

- Iron Maiden — 21 albums
- Led Zeppelin — 14 albums
- Deep Purple — 11 albums
- Metallica — 10 albums
- U2 — 10 albums

I counted albums per artist from the Album table and ranked them by album count. Note there is a tie for 4th/5th place: Metallica and U2 both have 10 albums.
sql_used:
SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist a
LEFT JOIN Album al USING(ArtistId)
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, a.Name ASC;

SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist a
LEFT JOIN Album al USING(ArtistId)
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
HAVING album_count >= 10
ORDER BY album_count DESC, a.Name ASC;
SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId IN (90,22,58,50,150) ORDER BY Name;

SELECT a.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist a
JOIN Album al USING(ArtistId)
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, a.Name ASC
LIMIT 5;
